changes.zh: 修复 `fillin/width=auto` 在 A3 双栏右栏中误用负的 `linegoal` 剩余宽度，导致隐藏答案时下划线异常跨行或超出栏宽的问题（GitHub #50）
changes.en: Fixed `fillin/width=auto` in the right column of A3 two-column layouts, where a negative remaining `linegoal` width caused hidden-answer underlines to wrap incorrectly or overflow the column.
